claims.claim_text: Daily aspirin 81 mg or 1000 mg, or placebo, added to the first 60 days of anti-tuberculosis drugs and dexamethasone.
Subgroup analysis in microbiologically confirmed TBM showed potential reduction in new infarcts and deaths by day 60 (p=0.06).
aspirin reduced the occurrence of any adenoma by 17%
daily aspirin treatment for about five years was associated with a 34% reduction in 20-year CRC mortality
aspirin reduced the occurrence of advanced adenomas by 28%
there was a 50% or more reduction in the risk of CRC commencing five years after randomization
Major and clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding: hazard ratio 0.68 (95% CI 0.22-2.16) for apixaban vs aspirin.
Serious adverse event rates: 43.9 per 100 person-years apixaban vs 45.7 aspirin.
New ischemic lesions: 13.6% apixaban vs 16.0% aspirin, adjusted odds ratio 0.79 (95% CI 0.42-1.48, P=0.57).
patients that were taking aspirin had a 21% reduction in prostate cancer risk
long-term users of daily low dose aspirin had a 29% prostate cancer risk reduction as compared to the controls
